## Changes: * #4468: Update GitHub Copilot to version 1.0.6 * #4467: Refactor Copilot CLI session request handling to ensure commits happen on last request * #4465: feat: programmatic ATIF trajectory export with agentOnly filtering * #4464: Add autoAttachReferences option to custom agent configurations * #3959: debugging/evals: allow static overrides of system prompts and tooldescriptions * #4370: Fix duplicate semantic search results from git worktrees * #4463: Sessions - remove the update branch action for the time being * #4454: Fix for Copilot CLI links with multiple sessions across single and multiple terminal * #4377: Send context signals in routing predict request * #4457: Hide claude models that are not model picker eligible
See More * #4458: Update Copilot Chat changelog for 1.112 (main branch) * #4455: Rate limit messaging * #4403: Bump undici * #4453: nes: debt: remove `EmitFastCursorLineChange#Always` * #4439: nes: fix: don't error if server response contained no choices * #4384: Fix: NES debounce and language context fetch do not honor cancellation token * #4434: Add experiment flag to force extended thinking on adaptive models * #4418: Implement ChatCustomAgentsService and integrate with CopilotCLI agents * #4435: nes: smarter rebase when user types in agreement with suggestion * #4420: Disable MCP support in Copilot CLI * #4427: nes: patch-based: test: ensure trailing newline is no issue * #4425: Fix 'Hide Ghost Requests' not filtering ghost prompt groups * #4424: Better project setup skill description * #4423: Implement pending commit handling for worktree changes in chat sessions * #4422: NES: add isFromCache to ET * #4419: update version to 0.40 This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=420937&view=logs).
